# F&S VENTURES LLC

> F&S VENTURES LLC is a Delaware limited liability company based in Minnetonka, Minnesota. It builds and operates small, focused software products for businesses, each aimed at one specific, recurring problem.

## Products

- [LedgerMedic](https://ledgermedic.com): software for keeping your books clean and your ledger honest, for small businesses that want accurate bookkeeping without a full-time accountant.
- [Sprinklerly](https://sprinklerly.com): software for running and scheduling irrigation and sprinkler service work, including jobs, routes and customers.
